data.name: Amaneh
data.gender_notes: Amaneh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is trustworthy, hopeful, and reliable. The name Amaneh carries the meaning “Hope, Trust” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Persian. Parents who choose Amaneh usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, trust and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents trust and hope in Allah
data.etymology: Amaneh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hope, Trust.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amaneh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أمانة
in_arabic.meaning: أمانة تعني الأمان والثقة والصدق في العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: أمانة هي اسم مؤنث في اللغة العربية، مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'أمِنَ' والذي يعني الأمان والثقة. يشير الاسم إلى الصدق والأمانة في التعامل، وهي صفات محمودة في الإسلام. وردت كلمة أمانة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَأَمَانَةً إِلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ' (الأحزاب: 33)، حيث تشير إلى الأمانة التي حملها الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم.

in_urdu.name: امانہ
in_urdu.meaning: امانہ کا مطلب ہے امانت، اعتماد، اور سچائی
in_urdu.long_meaning: امانہ ایک اردو نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے امانت، اعتماد، اور سچائی۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے جذر 'أمِنَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محفوظ رہنا یا سچا ہونا۔ اسلامی روایت میں، امانہ ایک اہم صفت ہے جس پر مسلمانوں کو عمل کرنا چاہئے۔ قرآن کریم میں امانہ کی اہمیت پر بار بار زور دیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ احزاب میں: 'وَأَمَانَةً إِلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ' (الأحزاب: 33)۔

in_hindi.name: अमानह
in_hindi.meaning: अमानह का अर्थ है अमानत, विश्वास, और सच्चाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमानह एक हिंदी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है अमानत, विश्वास, और सच्चाई। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के मूल 'أمِنَ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षित रहना या सच्चा होना। भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में, अमानह एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो ईमानदारी और सच्चाई के मूल्यों को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: امانه
in_pashto.meaning: امانه د امانت، باوري او صداقت معنا لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: امانه د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی چې د امانت، باوري او صداقت معنا لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د ريښې 'أمِنَ' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د خوندي پاتې کیدو يا سچا کیدو معنی لري. په افغاني او پښتني دود کې، امانه يو مهم نوم دی چې د صداقت او امانت د ارزښتونو څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Amaneh
in_english.meaning: Amaneh means trust, safety, and honesty in English
in_english.long_meaning: Amaneh is a name derived from the Arabic root 'أمِنَ', which means to be safe or secure. In Islamic tradition, Amaneh signifies trust, safety, and honesty. The Quran mentions the concept of amana (trust) in several verses, emphasizing its importance in Muslim life. The name Amaneh reflects desirable qualities such as reliability, sincerity, and faithfulness.

In a society that values trust, loyalty, and commitment, individuals bearing this name are esteemed for their virtues and character. The name "Amaneh" is a term of endearment for those children who are hoped to grow up to be responsible, trustworthy, and dependable individuals. In social interactions, this name can be used to denote trust, establishing a bond of trust between friends, or to give a term of reassurance and comfort.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Amaneh" also carries significant spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. Amanah in the Arabic language translates to trust or faith. It implies placing one's full trust in God and pursuing a righteous path in life. This spiritual significance can be interpreted as a reminder to bear the name with honor and dignity, fulfilling both the expectations of society and the teachings of Islam. By striving to be trustworthy and dependable in all aspects of life, individuals can deepen their spiritual connection with God and bring hope and positivity to those around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Hope, Trust" symbolizes One who is trustworthy, hopeful, and reliable. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Amaneh serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of hope, trust.
